events.headline: US LAUNCHES FRESH STRIKES AS IRAN CLOSES STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: The strikes follow an attack on a Cyrpus-flagged vessel travelling through the critical waterway.

events.headline: ESTADOS UNIDOS E IRÁN SE ENZARZAN EN UNA NUEVA ESPIRAL DE ATAQUES
events.detail: Las fuerzas estadounidenses han bombardeado Irán de nuevo después de que la Guardia Revolucionaria abriera fuego contra un carguero chipriota en el estrecho de Ormuz y declarase cerrada esa vía maríti

events.headline: IRAN WAR LIVE: US BOMBS IRANIAN PORT CITIES AS IRGC CLOSES STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: Explosions heard in the port cities of Bandar Abbas, Sirik, Chabahar, Bandar-e Deyr and Asaluyeh as US attacks continue.

events.headline: US LAUNCHES THIRD WAVE OF STRIKES AGAINST IRAN
events.detail: The US has launched a third wave of strikes against Iran this week in response to renewed attacks on ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: IRAN DECLARES STRAIT OF HORMUZ CLOSED UNTIL US ENDS ‘ILLEGAL’ INTERVENTIONS
events.detail: Iran has declared the Strait of Hormuz closed to all shipping until the US ends what Tehran called its “illegal” interventions in the region Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: HORMUZ SHIPPING IN FOCUS AS IRAN-US RHETORIC HEATS UP
events.detail: Analysts say door to diplomacy still open despite exchange of attacks and threats.
